originalRequest: Create a local educational web application for Linux users that explains user crontab lines and generates valid cron lines from Brazilian Portuguese requests without executing or installing anything.
safetyApproach: disposable project-content copy excluding existing RB state, dependencies, and build output

questions.question: Which stack should the local web app use?
questions.recommendedValue: Vite + React + TypeScript single-page app, fully client-side
questions.recommendedRationale: No backend is needed since nothing is executed; a static SPA enforces the no-execution constraint and runs locally with one command.
questions.selectedValue: Vite + React + TypeScript single-page app, fully client-side

questions.question: How broad should Brazilian Portuguese generation coverage be for the MVP?
questions.recommendedValue: A documented set of common patterns (every N minutes/hours, daily at a time, specific weekdays, monthly day, reboot), with a friendly 'nao entendi' message otherwise
questions.recommendedRationale: Keeps the deterministic parser reliable and testable while covering most educational cases.
questions.selectedValue: A documented set of common patterns (every N minutes/hours, daily at a time, specific weekdays, monthly day, reboot), with a friendly 'nao entendi' message otherwise

questions.question: Which timezone should the next-run preview use?
questions.recommendedValue: The browser's local timezone, shown explicitly in the UI
questions.recommendedRationale: Matches how the user's own cron daemon behaves and needs no configuration.
questions.selectedValue: The browser's local timezone, shown explicitly in the UI

precedingIdenticalAttempt.finding: The corrective intent retained one silent RIGID architecture default, so Core rejected it after the bounded second attempt.

qualitativeAssessment.limitation: vnext init did not inspect existing application source, so this greenfield plan diverges from cron_facility's implemented server and optional-AI architecture and must not replace its existing plan.
